subject: Blackbox verification & change-telemetry packet for SIG intake
messages:
From: Claire Thompson <claire.thompson@assessor.co>
To: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: acme-risk@acme.com
Date: 2025-09-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: SIG intake — request for blackbox evidence and CI telemetry

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the quick intro earlier. Acme's security team has a SIG intake scheduled next week and we need to collect a compact packet of Secure SDLC artifacts for their review. To keep this scoped we are requesting the following: 

1) A simple index (CSV) enumerating the artifacts you will provide and the time windows they cover.
2) CI/CD telemetry for the last 30 days (builds, agent IDs, durations, and outcomes).
3) A short sample of code-review evidence (one merged PR with reviewer comments redacted as needed).
4) Change-management chronology for any production deploys in the last 90 days.
5) A short attestation (one paragraph) confirming redaction approach and retention policy for the provided artifacts.

If possible please deliver a drive link and attach anything < 10MB inline. The SIG intake team is most interested in demonstrable telemetry and an auditable change timeline.

Can you confirm what you can provide by end of week?

Best,
Claire
Claire Thompson
Senior Assessor — Acme Risk

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Thompson <claire.thompson@assessor.co>
Cc: jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2025-09-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake — request for blackbox evidence and CI telemetry

Thanks Claire — we can assemble a compact packet that matches your checklist. High level plan:

- I will prepare the artifact index and an attestation paragraph.
- Jordan will export CI telemetry (last 30 days) and include agent IDs and build hashes.
- Kimberly will pull the change-management timeline and select a single representative merged PR for the code-review sample (we'll redact any commit-level secrets and personal data).

Two clarifying questions before we deliver:
1) For the code-review sample, do you need the full diff or only the PR conversation plus a minimal patch? We can supply either; smaller is better for inline delivery.
2) On redaction: we will redact email addresses and token strings, and will provide an attestation describing the redaction rules. Is that acceptable or do you require a review of our redaction script?

Target: initial packet (index + CI CSV + readme) by 2025-09-16 EOD, full attachments delivered via shared Drive link.

Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Security Compliance, Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com, claire.thompson@assessor.co
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2025-09-13T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake — CI telemetry export and notes

Hi all — attaching the CI telemetry export for the 30-day window (attached as ci-telemetry-202509.csv). Notes: 

- Fields included: build_id, timestamp, pipeline_name, agent_id (hashed), duration_seconds, outcome (success/failed/flaky), commit_hash (short).
- Agent IDs are hashed to preserve operator privacy; we include a map of agent types (runner, ephemeral) rather than raw hostnames.
- We removed any environment variables from the logs; artifact-level metadata and step durations are intact.

Also attaching a short snapshot of the change-telemetry summary we store (change-telemetry-snapshot.json) — this includes deploy events, author, and rollout tags (not raw secrets).

For the code-review sample I recommend we provide: 
- PR: 2025-07-21-feature/kv-cache-optimizations (merged)
- Attached patch: code-review-sample.patch (redacted of personal emails and API keys)
- We can instead provide the PR conversation and a minimal diff if you prefer smaller payloads.

Let me know if you want additional columns in the CI CSV.

—Jordan
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Claire Thompson <claire.thompson@assessor.co>
To: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2025-09-14T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake — quick follow-up

Thanks Jordan — that format looks good. Two quick asks before intake: 

- Please include a one-line signed attestation (name and title in the signature) confirming the redaction approach and that no live secrets are included. The assessor panel uses that for triage.
- For the change timeline: we need deploy identifiers and an approximation of the percentage rollout (can be categories: 100%, 50%, canary). If you can't disclose exact values, the coarse categories are fine.

If you can add those two items to the packet we'll be able to accept the compact bundle.

Cheers,
Claire

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Thompson <claire.thompson@assessor.co>
Cc: jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2025-09-16T15:23:00-07:00
Subject: Delivery: Blackbox verification & evidence packet (SIG compact)

Claire — attaching the compact packet per your checklist and follow-up. Files attached/uploaded to Drive (link below) and a quick index is included inline.

Attachment list (inline + drive):
- blackbox_evidence_index.csv — index of artifacts, windows, and redaction notes
- ci-telemetry-202509.csv — 30 day CI telemetry (agent IDs hashed; durations/outcomes included)
- change-telemetry-snapshot.json — deploy events with rollout category (canary/50%/100%)
- code-review-sample.patch — minimal merged PR patch with reviewer comments; emails redacted
- readme-evidence-map.md — short readme describing fields and retention policy

Signed attestation (below):
"I, Irene Choi, Head of Security Compliance at Redwood Inference, attest that the attached artifacts are representative sampling of our Secure SDLC telemetry and change records. All personal identifiers and secret material have been redacted; CI logs have been exported without environment variables or secret values. Retention for provided artifacts follows our standard evidence retention policy (90 days snapshot for SIG intake)."

Signature:
Irene Choi
Head of Security Compliance
Redwood Inference

Drive link (shared, view-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/fake/blackbox-packet
HubSpot intake: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/ACME — record attached.

Notes for the assessor: 
- Deploy rollout categories are provided in change-telemetry-snapshot.json as "rollout": "canary" | "50%" | "100%". Exact host counts suppressed.
- If you need an unredacted sample under an NDA or in a controlled environment, we can arrange an assessor-only session.

Let us know if you need anything else prior to your intake.

Best,
Irene
Head of Security Compliance, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0124
notes: Delivered compact SIG packet; internal coordination documented. Redaction and privacy-preserving exports used for assessor consumption.
